title: ChurchMediaPackInput
description: Input data schema for generating a weekly church media and visual creative pack.

series_or_sermon_title.description: The title of the sermon or series (e.g., Unshakeable: Trusting God in Uncertain Times).

big_idea.description: The central theological takeaway or focus of the message.

aesthetic_mood.description: Visual style (e.g., Moody cinematic film, Minimalist modern typography, Vibrant watercolor, Warm organic earthy).
aesthetic_mood.default: Cinematic warm lighting with clean negative space
